title: AgentEvent
description: What an agent is about to do on the device, and whether it worked. A viewer draws the intent with its own pointer.

Point.description: A point on the screen as fractions of its width and height.

kind.description: What it is: tap, long_press, swipe, drag, type, press, look, app or build. A viewer draws kinds it does not know as a caption.

points.description: Where it lands, in order; empty for a gesture with no place on the screen.

AgentIntent.description: A gesture about to land. While anyone watches, the server waits lead_ms after sending it, so the pointer arrives first.

pointer.description: False when the agent cursor is off: an agent is using the device, and nothing is drawn.

label.description: The label of the element the gesture lands on, if it has one.

AgentDone.description: The gesture an intent announced is over.
